title: Projects & Mastery Practice 3
statement:
Module 6 (Projects & Mastery) covers: html in modern frameworks, progressive web apps basics, web performance, accessibility auditing, internationalization, capstone: build a page. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 3: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Web Performance).
hints: Re-read the Web Performance lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
